Expertise Track. Applies to all weapon and unarmed attacks you are trained in, regardless of group or category.

From 1st Level

  • Your proficiency rank is one rank higher than your classes would normally grant, up to Mythic.
  • Add a damage bonus to your Strikes equal to your proficiency rank.

Minimum Rank

  • Your proficiency rank is at least Master at 5th level, Legendary at 10th, and Mythic at 15th.

Classes That Begin at Expert

  • If a class makes you Expert with a weapon at 1st level, as the Fighter and Gunslinger do, you stay a rank ahead of the minimum with it: Master at 1st, Legendary at 5th, and Mythic at 13th.
  • At 15th level, your Strikes with those weapons gain one additional weapon damage die. This stacks with striking runes.

Enhanced Defense

  • Your Armor Class increases by 1 at 1st level, 2 at 5th, 3 at 10th, and 4 at 15th.
    • This is not a bonus and stacks with all bonuses to Armor Class.

Mythic Proficiency

Mythic is a new proficiency rank found only through this ruleset, granting a proficiency bonus equal to your level + 10.

In Foundry: every weapon proficiency you are trained in is one rank above what your classes give and never below the minimum, including weapon-group proficiencies such as the Gunslinger's firearms and crossbows. A proficiency either class made Expert at 1st level follows the Master, Legendary, Mythic ladder from 1st, 5th and 13th. Mythic shows on the Strike's attack breakdown as Mythic, worth your level + 10; the sheet's proficiency list stops at Legendary, which is the highest rank PF2e stores. The damage bonus follows the rank of the weapon you strike with: 4 Expert, 6 Master, 8 Legendary, 10 Mythic. From 15th, a Strike with an Expert-start weapon adds one die of that weapon's own damage die, which stacks with striking runes and doubles on a critical hit. The Enhanced Defense increase applies automatically. A character built before version 0.1.3 keeps the old ranks until the GM runs Refresh talent rules.
